title: Viernes killing: Councilor Labra asks police to pursue all leads

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The circumstances surrounding the death of a man whose remains were found buried beneath cement have prompted a city councilor to urge police to pursue every credible lead and establish what happened to him. Cebu City Councilor Pablo “Paul” Labra II made the call during his privilege speech on Tuesday, October 20. Isaac Viernes’ remains were found in a vacant lot in Barangay Pahina Central on Monday. Labra chairs the Committee on Public Order and Safety, Labra urged the Cebu City Police Office (CCPO) to examine available evidence, follow leads, and determine the circumstances surrounding Viernes’ disappearance […]...
